XSS Test: Image Onerror Injection

This page contains selectable text with an embedded img tag using onerror. If the extension is vulnerable to XSS, the onerror handler would execute.

Select this text: <img src="x" onerror="alert('XSS-IMG')"> and then this text.

Note: The img tag above is HTML-escaped and does not execute. This tests whether the extension properly handles text that looks like XSS.

Expected Behavior:
  • No alert dialog should appear
  • The img tag should be sanitized
  • The overlay should show the text safely
